sn56.29:1.3: dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.29:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ atthi ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyaṃ atthi ariyasaccaṃ pahātabbaṃ atthi ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ atthi ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ.
sn56.29:2.2: dukkhaṃ bhikkhave ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ pahātabbaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ.
sn56.29:3.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
